code_title: FIA International Sporting Code & Formula One Sporting Regulations

ART_33_3.title: Causing an Avoidable Collision
ART_33_3.description: At no time may a car be driven unnecessarily slowly, erratically or in a manner which could be deemed potentially dangerous to other drivers. Causing an avoidable collision will result in a judicial penalty.

ART_33_4.title: Failure to Leave Racing Room (Crowding)
ART_33_4.description: Any driver defending a position must leave at least one car width (2.0m) between their car and the edge of the track when an alongside competitor has established significant overlap.

ART_DRIVING_STANDARDS_APEX.title: Apex Right of Way & Late Divebomb
ART_DRIVING_STANDARDS_APEX.description: In order for a car being overtaken to be required to give room, the attacking car's front axle must be at least alongside the mirror or front axle of the other car prior to turn-in (minimum 50% overlap).

ART_RACING_INCIDENT.article_id: FIA ISC Appendix L Chapter IV §2
ART_RACING_INCIDENT.title: Racing Incident (No Further Action)
ART_RACING_INCIDENT.regulatory_reference: FIA ISC Appendix L Chapter IV Article 2(d)
ART_RACING_INCIDENT.description: If it is established that neither driver was wholly or predominantly to blame for an incident or contact during genuine racing contest, no further action shall be taken.
